name: Camping Grubhof
beschreibung: Camping Grubhof is located in St. Martin bei Lofer in the Tiroler Saalachtal. The site offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, as well as several rental accommodations. On the grounds there are sanitary facilities, a Brötchen service station, and a small grocery store. Guests can use tennis courts, a children's playground, and a football pitch. The surrounding area is ideal for hiking, cycling, and excursions to the Loferer Steinberge.
